title: Wakezone Watersports Key Largo
specs: Open-water free-ride jet ski rentals with no tracks or restrictions
Locations in Key Largo, Conch Key, and Marathon with access to reefs, sandbars, and backcountry flats
Guided sunset tours near iconic landmarks like Seven Mile Bridge and Sombrero Reef
Operator must be at least 18 years old
Passengers must be at least 6 years old
Florida boater safety education certificate required if born on or after January 1, 1988
On-site temporary safety test available if no certificate
Multiple jet skis can be rented for groups; call ahead to confirm availability
includes: Fuel included in all boat rentals
Life jackets provided for all riders and passengers

addons.name: Half Day (4 hrs) Up to 12 passengers

blurb: Guests rent high-speed Yamaha WaveRunners for open-water jet ski rides or guided sunset tours. Boat rentals include pontoons and tritoons with fuel and safety gear included. Locations are in Key Largo, Conch Key, and Marathon, offering access to clear waters, reefs, and sandbars.
extraNote: Same-day bookings available when slots are open · Call 682-320-0122 to confirm availability and check-in location · Arrive 20–30 minutes early for check-in, waivers, and safety briefing · Amoray Dive Resort, 104250 Overseas Hwy, Key Largo, FL 33037 for Key Largo jet skis; Conch Key Marina for boat rentals and jet skis; Gulf View Waterfront Resort, 58743 Overseas Hwy, Marathon, FL 33050 for Marathon jet skis.
